why_it_moved.text: The mechanism is unknown: the scorecard has no segment cuts, so we can't say which queries gained.
why_it_moved.label: guess

why_it_moved.text: On triggered searches the rate rose 1.9%; triggered searches carry 20.5% of control successes, so the overall lift is 0.39%.
why_it_moved.label: measured

would_change: A team decision that an overall lift of 0.39% is worth taking would settle the trade-off at triage.
A pre-exposure comparison and a daily series by days since first exposure would show whether the lift holds steady; a fading lift would lower the case.
